review_text: The cart screen freezes every time I attempt to apply a discount coupon code during checkout. I missed out on the holiday sale because of this bug!
Our team account was charged twice for the annual plan renewal. We tried reaching billing support, but the ticket has been pending for 3 days.
Fantastic UI overhaul! The search filter speed is dramatically faster and saving favorite items is super intuitive now.
Order tracking map links return 404 errors on iOS. Customers have no way to track delivery status.
The PDF exporter generates blank documents when exporting financial reports larger than 50 pages.
